scope: Pre-calibration comparison of a controlled factorial calibration cohort; no independent/global VoiceOver accuracy claim. Reuses prior Native HTML and calibration groups; contrasts Tab/VO entry with a 5000ms observation horizon. Preserve action clocks and hint receipt times. No causal completion claim. Native collected for both browsers before any speech-engine change. All planned actions retained. Once inspected, this cohort is regression. Hint candidate equality is not speech queue behavior; state transitions verify prediction inputs rather than whole-engine State Accuracy.

plan.scope: Controlled timing follow-up: identical native checkbox pages reused from the preceding calibration group; Tab versus VO first/return entry, description absent/present, physical Space changes. Minimum observation horizon 5000ms for every action. Preserve original receipt times and examine whether entry hints arrive before later state-change requests. No independent/general accuracy claim.
metrics: conditional eligible speech and all-plan match rates
plan.inputEquivalence: Retain every planned row. Require independently visible unique geometry candidate, matching AX target role/name, current checked state, AXCustomContent/AXHelp and independent before/after checked-state changes; retain unverified/unstable target or ancestor context as unknown. Keyboard focus alone does not prove a reading target.
plan.attribution: Existing wire-request-v1 bounded-window quality check; no native speech-completion guarantee. Predict before Native collection; never feed observed speech or target corrections into predictions.
plan.failurePolicy: No engine or input changes until both browsers finish. Inspected cohort becomes regression. No Navigation or Task Success claim. Native checked-state transition observations verify speech inputs, not whole-engine State Accuracy.
plan.mainPolicy: Existing normalized Main Speech plus case/punctuation-preserving whitespace-only exact diagnostic. Help prefix classification requires actual observed AXHelp, never predicted help.
plan.fullPolicy: Literal main/hint candidate equality; candidate is not a queue scheduler. Keep missing/repeated hints distinct from main wording and preserve raw receipts.
